termos.intro: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of the IBBF Platform, a member, family, and ministry management system maintained by 1st Fundamentalist Bible Baptist Church of Canoas ("Church", "we"). By creating an account or accessing the platform, you agree to the conditions described below.
termos.objetoTexto: The platform is intended for the Church's internal use to register and track members, congregants, visitors, families, and participation in ministries, and is restricted to individuals authorized by leadership.
termos.cadastroTexto: Access is granted through a personal, non-transferable account. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activities carried out with your credentials. Report any unauthorized use of your account immediately.
termos.usoTexto: The data available on the platform must be used exclusively for purposes related to the Church's administration and pastoral care. It is forbidden to extract, share, or use member and family information for purposes unrelated to this purpose.
termos.niveisTexto: Permissions within the platform vary according to the role held in the Church (leadership, secretary, members, among others). The Church may adjust or revoke access at any time, especially in cases of misuse.
termos.disponibilidadeTexto: We may change, suspend, or discontinue platform features at any time, always seeking to communicate relevant changes with reasonable notice.
termos.alteracoesTexto: These terms may be updated periodically. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes agreement with the current version.
termos.contatoTexto: Questions about these terms may be directed to the secretary's office of 1st Fundamentalist Bible Baptist Church of Canoas.

privacidade.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how 1st Fundamentalist Bible Baptist Church of Canoas ("Church", data controller) processes personal data collected through the IBBF Platform, in accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018 – LGPD).
privacidade.dadosColetadosIntro: We may process the following data from members, congregants, and visitors:
dadosColetadosItens: Identification data: full name, national ID (CPF), and date of birth
Contact data: phone number and address
Church-related data: family, membership status, baptism, and participation in ministries
Access data: email and account authentication credentials
privacidade.dadoSensivelTexto: The LGPD classifies data revealing religious belief as sensitive personal data (art. 5, II). We process this data only for the Church's statutory purposes, based on the data subject's consent and/or the legitimate interest of a religious organization to manage its own members (art. 11, II, "e", of the LGPD).
privacidade.finalidadeTexto: Data is used to organize members and families, conduct ministries, institutional communication, and pastoral care, and is not used for commercial purposes.
privacidade.compartilhamentoTexto: We do not sell or share personal data with third parties for marketing purposes. Internal access is restricted to authorized leaders and staff, according to each user's permission level. We may disclose data when required by law or court order.
privacidade.armazenamentoTexto: We adopt reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, or improper alteration.
privacidade.direitosIntro: Under art. 18 of the LGPD, you may request, at any time:
direitosItens: Confirmation of the existence of processing and access to the data
Correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data
Anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary data
Portability of data to another service provider
Withdrawal of consent and deletion of data processed based on it
privacidade.retencaoTexto: Data is kept for as long as the data subject's relationship with the Church lasts or as necessary for the purposes described, and may be retained for an additional period to comply with legal obligations.
privacidade.contatoTexto: Requests related to personal data may be made directly to the secretary's office of 1st Fundamentalist Bible Baptist Church of Canoas.
